description: Code quality lint rules for TypeScript — enforces explicit types, const preference, and clean logging

logging.description: Enforce structured logging over console output

rules.description: No console.log in production TypeScript — use a structured logger
rules.message: Replace console.log with your project's structured logger

rules.description: Public functions should declare explicit return types
rules.message: Consider adding an explicit return type to exported functions

rules.description: Avoid non-null assertion operator (!) — signals possible null-safety issue
rules.message: Non-null assertion hides potential null errors — use optional chaining or a null check

rules.description: Prefer const over let for values that are never reassigned
rules.message: Consider using const if this variable is never reassigned

react-nextjs.description: React and Next.js App Router patterns

rules.description: useSearchParams() must be inside a Suspense-wrapped component in Next.js 15 App Router
rules.message: useSearchParams() causes a prerender failure in Next.js 15 App Router unless the calling component is wrapped by <Suspense>. Extract into an inner component (e.g. function PageContent()) and render as <Suspense fallback={...}><PageContent /></Suspense> inside the page default export.

exact-optional-types.description: Patterns required when exactOptionalPropertyTypes is enabled

rules.description: Do not pass T|undefined directly to an optional prop when exactOptionalPropertyTypes is enabled
rules.message: With exactOptionalPropertyTypes:true, passing 'string|undefined' to an optional prop 'prop?: string' is a type error. Use conditional rendering: {v !== undefined ? <Component prop={v} /> : <Component />} or conditional spread: {...(v !== undefined ? { prop: v } : {})}. Never suppress with 'as' cast.
